easyPrerequisites: You control and own two additional nontoken artifacts.
description:
Activate Radiant Lotus by tapping it, sacrificing it and two other nontoken artifacts except Codex Shredder, adding {6}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Second Sunrise by paying {1}{W}{W}, causing each player to return all artifact, creature, enchantment and land cards that were put into a graveyard this turn to the battlefield under their owner's control.
Activate Codex Shredder's second ability by paying {5}, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Second Sunrise from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
